_comment: Example MCP server definitions. Copy the entries you want into the file
MCP_SERVERS_JSON points at (mcp_servers.json by default) and delete this
Keys starting with an underscore are ignored by nothing: remove them.
Every server key becomes a CONNECTOR name, so it must not collide with a
built-in connector (web_search, find_places, and the finance tools).
A collision is refused and logged at boot.
